scientific_review: Four prior validated processed source profiles now have point features with distinct source clocks, frames and depth metadata. No new primary measurements or independent observations.

New diagnostic minimum connected vertical support is an inclusive lower bound on reconstructed joint signed-component/salinity support; it is not physical current thickness. Resolved upper crossing and deepest native supported sample remain distinct from physical top and bottom.

No geographic axis or between-anchor interpolation, width join, area, volume, seasonal envelope or whole-route physical profile. All818 prior references and old projection inventories remain unchanged.

Source byte bindings, arithmetic on supported extents, positions and preservation of every original field validated in cloud. Tests reject changed input bytes, bottom/surface substitutions, broken crossing/core support and temporal/identity/volume upgrades.
Seven tests plus actual build sequentially one idle cloud CPU. No ocean requests, archive parsing or local scientific execution. Exact successful artifact retained once.
